# JSZip (vendored)

- Version: 3.10.1
- File: `jszip.min.js`
- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js
- Global exposed: `window.JSZip`
- License: MIT or GPLv3 dual license (see https://github.com/Stuk/jszip)

Used to unzip `.mxl` (compressed MusicXML) files client-side to reach the inner `.musicxml` entry.

To update: bump the version in the source URL above and re-download.
